entities.name: Union of Brest & 17th-Century Wars
entities.label: EventWindow
entities.summary: The Union of Brest (1596) created the Greek Catholic (Uniate) Church, dividing Belarusian society. The devastating Russo-Polish War (1654–1667) and the Swedish Deluge killed up to half the population.
